headline: The clap test is a command now
lede: PLAICRAFT's hardest acceptance line — audio lined up with the game frames to within ±50 ms — ships today as `npm run plaicraft:clap`: synthesized claps fire while the harness taps the matching pad, and the verdict runs on real recorded bytes through the same consent gate your phone would meet. Three claps, worst offset +21 ms; a planted 500 ms desync goes RED and names every pair.

notes.text: PR #1772 squash-merged (Part of #1711): clapSync.js pure verdict + 9 new recordcheck gates (73 total, three mutants pinned red) + the browser driver with a stub store, so the alignment proof needs no R2 bucket — it re-runs unchanged against the real store when #1730 lands.

Headless-shell audio traps, documented in the Gauntlet README for whoever builds on this: clicks must be baked into ONE looping AudioBuffer started at t=0 (future-scheduled sources and ScriptProcessor state silently vanish in shell+sp), and clap content must be low-frequency — opus eats nyquist crackle whole.

#1711 keeps `building` per big-build rules: Jon's 3 phone sessions into the store still await the R2 bucket (#1730, AWAITING until ~Nov 8); `npm run plaicraft:evidence` is ready to close with evidence the moment it binds.
